intro: Prospector Ryedol sends you to Ironforge with Hammertoe's Amulet. Historian Karnik and Hammertoe were working together to find the lost artifacts of Uldaman, and Ryedol guesses the Shadowforge found out the pair knew more than they let on.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Okay, okay... Who would know what to do?
He's in Ironforge. He'll be able to help. He and Hammertoe were workin' together to find the lost artifacts in Uldaman.
Guess the Shadowforge found out the two of them knew more than they were lettin' on.
Tell Karnik what's happened to Hammertoe and give him the amulet--he'll tell you what needs to be done next.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, yes. Another traveler seeking something from the dwarves.
Friend, I'm truly sorry, but I've no time to answer meaningless questions right now.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh! Well, this is a different matter entirely. You probably don't realize the gravity of this matter yet, do you?
I care deeply about Hammertoe's demise, but if he sent you here with his amulet, then he understood what's at stake.
We will have to take time to mourn his death later.
Let me show you one of the reasons this amulet is so valuable.
